roles.description: Handles broad responsibilities for the current Assignment.
instructions: Clarify the task, choose evidence-based actions and report uncertainty explicitly.
evaluation_criteria: The assigned responsibility is visibly completed.

instructions: Explore multiple possibilities before committing to one.

evaluation_criteria: The assigned writing responsibility is fulfilled.

roles.description: Improves structure and clarity while preserving authorial intent.
instructions: Inspect structure, pacing, consistency and unnecessary complexity.
Prefer actionable revisions supported by specific evidence.
evaluation_criteria: Revisions preserve intent and address the assigned issue.

roles.description: Evaluates clarity, engagement and emotional effect.
instructions: Evaluate clarity, engagement and emotional effect from an external perspective.
Separate personal reaction from observable textual evidence.
evaluation_criteria: Feedback is tied to observable reader experience.

instructions: Trace affected interfaces before editing and verify observable behavior after changes.
evaluation_criteria: The assigned change is implemented and verified.

roles.description: Reviews evidence, correctness and operational risk.
instructions: Search for regressions, unsupported claims and boundary violations before accepting a change.
evaluation_criteria: Material defects and boundary risks are reported.
